title: Keep restricted-label refusal order and remedy documentation accurate
outcome: Restricted-label import refusals name unsupported fields in document order and explain the currently supported operator choices without implying an unavailable import re-baseline operation.
acceptance: When a restricted-ness label edit is combined with lifecycle or another later document field, unsupported_fields lists labels before that field, with a regression test.

The Git task-sync and task-planning-text briefs state the actual supported remedy or explicitly state no supported import route exists for changing restricted-ness; they do not imply task-sync prepare --rebaseline can perform that import.
